What do we do?

Revenue work is scattered. We bring it under one roof.

Most hotels piece revenue management together from a PMS, a pricing tool, a rate shopper, a BI dashboard, an OTA marketing agency, a reputation tool and a stack of spreadsheets. BFIS runs the whole cycle on one data foundation, starting with our own PMS, so every decision uses the same numbers and every result is reported in one place.

00  ·  THE FOUNDATION
BFIS PMS
Where every revenue decision starts.
Live

Our cloud property management system, running live hotels today. The tape chart shows every room, every night and every guest at a glance, with room status, folios, rates and reports one click away, and its data flows straight into pricing, reporting and loyalty.

1
Tape chart: every room by night, with occupancy and availability for each day, tooltips, rates and room locks.
2
Live room status: vacant or occupied, clean, dirty or in maintenance, so the front desk and housekeeping work from the same screen.
3
Front desk & folios: new folios, check-ins, cashiering, guest messages and reports, all from the top bar.
4
Multi-property: switch hotels from one login. Its data feeds PriceCortex™, FolioLens™ and GoldKey automatically.
BFIS PMS login →See how the data is used
AI + human oversight

Advanced AI and machine learning. Guarded by a human Revenue Manager.

Machines are fast at reading thousands of signals. People are good at judgement. BFIS uses both: our models forecast and recommend, hard guardrails keep every number inside your limits, and a dedicated Revenue Manager reviews and approves before anything reaches your guests.

AI & ML models
Machine

Read your PMS pace, booking curves, competitor rates and market data, then forecast demand and recommend rates for every room.

Guardrails
Rules you set

Floors, ceilings and your business rules are enforced on every recommendation. No model can cross them.

Human Revenue Manager
Your RM

Reviews each recommendation with its full reasoning, adjusts where judgement says so, and approves, in the portal or on WhatsApp.

Live & measured
Results

Approved rates go live. Every decision is logged and scored afterwards, so the models and the team keep learning.

Never a black box

Each recommendation carries its full audit trail: the pace signal, the competitor position, the guardrail that applied. Your Revenue Manager sees exactly why, and so can you.

Floor & ceiling locksApproval before go-liveFull audit trailDecision scoring

A person you can call

Every hotel has a named Revenue Manager who knows your property, your market and your goals. Technology scales the work; the relationship stays human.

01 / 10  ·  PRICE
PriceCortex™
The right rate, every room, several times a day.
LiveAI + human RM
Developed by BFIS Labs

Every day, for every hotel, PriceCortex™ reads where the books are against where they should be, checks the market, and recommends a rate for each room category. Your Revenue Manager reviews the reasoning and approves.

1
On the books vs where they should be vs last year: rooms sold today, the target from your booking curve, and last year's final on the same day of the week.
2
Pace against the booking curve: how many rooms ahead or behind you are, so price moves are driven by real demand.
3
Recommended rate per room category, with the range across categories, kept inside your floors and ceilings.
4
RevPAR and demand pressure: recent RevPAR vs target and last year, and a 1-to-5 demand-pressure score.
